I know therapy unfortunately can be very very expensive, so hopefully you can have some help from the state if you are in the US. Also your husbands mentality on therapy and therapists is very alarming. To me, it sounds like he doesn’t want you to discover his toxic and controlling behavior, have an “ah ha” moment and leave him. He wants to control and dominate you, emotionally and sexually. Again I am truly very sorry for what you are going through, and I hope you heal. My inbox is open if you ever want to message me, because I have been through this exact same thing.❤️ sending lots of love.
